user.title: Add timer
user.description: Create a timer managed inside Smart Entity Timer. Each timer controls one entity and keeps its own state, preferences, and notifications. Available variables for notification titles and messages: {timer_name}, {target_name}, {target_entity}, {action}, {action_id}, {action_past}, {duration}, {duration_minutes}, {result}, {reason}, {finished_at}, {restored}, {default_title}, {default_message}. Leave any custom field blank to keep the built-in text.

data.name: Timer name
data.execute_expired_turn_off: Execute an expired turn-off after restart
data.execute_expired_turn_on: Execute an expired turn-on after restart

data_description.target_entity: Entity that will be turned on or off when the timer finishes.
data_description.notification_target: Optional. Select notify entities, devices, or areas that contain notify entities.
data_description.execute_expired_turn_off: Recommended: enabled. If Home Assistant was offline when an OFF timer expired, turn the entity off after startup.
data_description.execute_expired_turn_on: Recommended: disabled. Prevents unexpected activation after a long outage.
data_description.confirmation_timeout: How long to wait for the entity to confirm the requested state.
data_description.notification_error_message: Optional. Example: {target_name} could not complete {action}. Reason: {reason}.
data_description.notification_skipped_message: Optional. Example: {action} for {target_name} was skipped. Reason: {reason}.
data_description.notification_auto_cancel_message: Optional. Example: {target_name} reached the requested state before the timer finished.

reconfigure.title: Configure timer
reconfigure.description: Change the target entity and all preferences for this timer. Changes are applied when saved. An active timer cannot be reconfigured. Available variables for notification titles and messages: {timer_name}, {target_name}, {target_entity}, {action}, {action_id}, {action_past}, {duration}, {duration_minutes}, {result}, {reason}, {finished_at}, {restored}, {default_title}, {default_message}. Leave any custom field blank to keep the built-in text.
